description: This file implements the ProtobufCodec class for serializing and deserializing protocol buffer messages within the Orleans framework. It handles deep copying, type support checks, reading, and writing protobuf messages, and interacts with various selectors and parsers.

classes.name: ProtobufCodec
classes.description: A codec for serializing, deserializing, and copying protobuf message types within Orleans. Implements interfaces for general encoding, copying, and type filtering.

methods.name: ProtobufCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec with type selectors for serialization and copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a protobuf message, utilizing buffers and the message parser.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported by this codec based on selectors and message type.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a type is allowed for serialization or copying, based on protobuf message assignability.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a protobuf message value from the serialized data stream, handling type information and parsing.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into the data stream, including type information and message content.
